Name: Isaac Watts
Summary: English Nonconformist minister and hymn writer who broke the custom of singing only metrical psalms and wrote hundreds of hymns, including 'Joy to the World' and 'When I Survey the Wondrous Cross'.
Contribution: Remade English congregational song, giving the church hymns sung ever since, including paraphrases of the Psalms for ordinary voices.
KeyWorks: Hymns and Spiritual Songs; The Psalms of David Imitated
Testimony: He testified that the church should sing the Gospel in its own words, not only in borrowed psalm lines.
